description.value: Comfort Inn & Suites Surrey is a four-storey chain hotel in Surrey, BC offering room types ranging from standard queen rooms to Jacuzzi suites, pet-friendly rooms, and suites with kitchenettes. The hotel provides a complimentary hot breakfast buffet, free on-site parking with oversized vehicle spaces, a fitness centre, and an outdoor patio. It sits directly across from the Surrey Sports & Leisure Complex, giving touring cyclists convenient access to Olympic-sized indoor pools and additional fitness facilities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and corroborates the OSM record: phone 604-576-8888, address 8255-166th Street Surrey, and the site URL all match. The amenities page explicitly lists coin-operated laundry and free wireless high-speed internet, confirming those amenities. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, drying areas, e-bike charging, or any cycling-specific services appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, e-bike charging, bike procedures) mentioned anywhere on the website
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel with confirmed website, phone, and address. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking overnight accommodation in Surrey.
